name: Battle Girls
source: As the latest pilot to arrive in the Battle Mech training grounds a heavy burden is yours, to pilot a mech alongside one of several female co-pilots, with the aim of winning the mech wars and ensuring your country finally has an active role in the combined government.
translation: 作为最新抵达战斗机甲训练场的飞行员，你肩负着沉重的负担，与几名女性副驾驶员之一一起驾驶机甲，目标是赢得机甲战争并确保你的国家最终在联合政府中发挥积极作用。
